Welcome to the official music video of the hottest new "Haryanvi DJ song 2024" – "Matka" – brought to you by "Seema Films". This track is an absolute must-listen, featuring "Raj Mawar" and "Komal Chaudhary" in an electrifying collaboration with "Mannu Pahari" and "Bharti Chaudhary". The catchy beats, high-energy vibes, and catchy lyrics are sure to make you groove to this track all night long. Whether you're partying with friends, celebrating a festival, or just in the mood for some energetic "new Haryanvi DJ music", "Matka" will be your perfect companion!
